title: Build a Redacted Network Client
prompt: Configure one OkHttp client with correlation, authentication header, cache policy, safe logging, and tests that assert chain order and secret redaction.
successCriteria: Interceptors proceed correctly and preserve requests.
No credential or body appears in captured logs.
Client resources are shared across API calls.
hints: Write down the ownership and failure contract before choosing library APIs.
Prove one adverse or lifecycle case before improving presentation.

starterCode.code: fun buildClient(tokenStore: TokenStore, logger: SafeNetworkLogger): OkHttpClient

solutionOutline: Model immutable inputs, outputs, events, and failures at the boundary.
Implement the smallest correct path and verify every success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic state or protocol tests.
Inspect the relevant accessibility, lifecycle, concurrency, or network boundary.
